ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, heading strokes, default icon strokes, body copy

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body-level dark surfaces, secondary panel fills

udemy-sans.$description: Single-family system: weight 700 for display headlines, 500 for subheadings and nav labels, 400 for body and UI, 300 sparingly for muted large text. The custom face has open apertures and a humanist x-height — it reads as instructional, not corporate.
